name: lens-zoom
title: Lens Zoom
description: A fast fisheye lens push: the outgoing scene bulges and zooms into the lens with motion blur, a camera shake and a slight color fringe, then the incoming scene unwinds out of the same lens. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .lz-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A punchy, energetic cut between two high-energy scenes.
Sports, tech or music pieces that want a camera-whip feel.
avoidWhen: Text-heavy scenes: the fisheye distorts type.
author: Remocn
